# Modeling {#sec-modeling}

This chapter will introduce predictive modeling as a workflow built around a
well-defined target and an appropriate evaluation design. Planned topics
include baselines, training and test data, model assessment, interpretation,
and limits on claims from predictive performance. Model development will
revisit all four checks in @sec-formulation-checks, especially whether the
target, available predictors, and evaluation design support the intended use.
